2026-10-31.summary: No notable player-facing changes were identified in the latest development commits.

items.text: Renaming of horses and chickens now requires a tool cupboard nearby, preventing unauthorized renames.
Horse canter controls adjusted for smoother movement.
New seagull group spawn points added to deep‑sea monuments, creating dynamic flocks.
Fixed Tier 2 harbors on custom maps to spawn crates correctly.
Turn‑in‑place now respects parent yaw, eliminating odd rotation behavior.
Weapon addon points introduced, allowing new attachment options.
Quick‑craft UI now focusable and navigable with the D‑pad for console players.
Erosion system improved with bug fixes and per‑biome splat maps for more consistent terrain changes.
Store “NEW” notifications now correctly show new skins, and a NullReferenceException crash in the store grid has been resolved.
Streamer mode now correctly hides animal names in all relevant menus.
Crude oil pumped from sphere tanks now counts toward your oil production total.
World generation no longer places floating powerlines over caves; powerlines stay grounded.

2026-10-30.summary:
### Animals & Wildlife
- Renaming of horses and chickens now requires a tool cupboard nearby, preventing unauthorized renames.
- Horse canter controls adjusted for smoother movement.
- New seagull group spawn points added to deep‑sea monuments, creating dynamic flocks.

### Harbor & Loot
- Fixed Tier 2 harbors on custom maps to spawn crates correctly.

### Player Movement
- Turn‑in‑place now respects parent yaw, eliminating odd rotation behavior.

### Weapons & Crafting
- Weapon addon points introduced, allowing new attachment options.
- Quick‑craft UI now focusable and navigable with the D‑pad for console players.

### World & Terrain
- Erosion system improved with bug fixes and per‑biome splat maps for more consistent terrain changes.

### Store & UI
- Store “NEW” notifications now correctly show new skins, and a NullReferenceException crash in the store grid has been resolved.

### UI & Quality of Life
- Streamer mode now correctly hides animal names in all relevant menus.

### Economy
- Crude oil pumped from sphere tanks now counts toward your oil production total.

### World Generation
- World generation no longer places floating powerlines over caves; powerlines stay grounded.

items.text: Fixed full-height walls connecting incorrectly, removing visual glitches and wrong wall connections.
Added a voxel‑based flooding pass that improves base visibility and flags building blocks with missing sockets or bad connections.
Removed the UZI 9mm from the tech tree and crafting menu, so it can no longer be researched or built.
Fixed sight‑mod interactions that previously overrode ADS values when the stock was collapsed, restoring proper aiming.
Stopped monuments from spawning too close to rivers where terrain blends overlap, eliminating floating water issues.
Made the loadout delete confirmation popup interactive again, so deletions can be confirmed.
Fixed night‑vision goggle sound to play continuously during gestures.
Corrected the mortar ammo counter to update correctly.
Fixed crab and jellyfish behavior bugs and increased the visibility of rare blue crabs with stronger colour tints.
Fixed the beacon repair collider so it no longer blocks ladders, allowing smooth ladder climbing.
Admins can now use server commands to force gull groups to startle or land, allowing dynamic control of bird behavior.
Flock interest zones can be placed in monuments to attract bird flocks; corpses briefly draw crow flocks, and timed explosives cause flocks to flee, adding new strategic environmental interactions.
Bird hit‑registration bounds have been increased, keeping birds within hit‑reg range and making them easier to target in combat.

2026-10-29.summary:
### Base Building
- Fixed full-height walls connecting incorrectly, removing visual glitches and wrong wall connections.
- Added a voxel‑based flooding pass that improves base visibility and flags building blocks with missing sockets or bad connections.

### Weapons & Crafting
- Removed the UZI 9mm from the tech tree and crafting menu, so it can no longer be researched or built.
- Fixed sight‑mod interactions that previously overrode ADS values when the stock was collapsed, restoring proper aiming.

### World Generation
- Stopped monuments from spawning too close to rivers where terrain blends overlap, eliminating floating water issues.

### UI & Audio
- Made the loadout delete confirmation popup interactive again, so deletions can be confirmed.
- Fixed night‑vision goggle sound to play continuously during gestures.
- Corrected the mortar ammo counter to update correctly.

### Swarm AI
- Fixed crab and jellyfish behavior bugs and increased the visibility of rare blue crabs with stronger colour tints.

### World Interaction
- Fixed the beacon repair collider so it no longer blocks ladders, allowing smooth ladder climbing.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Admins can now use server commands to force gull groups to startle or land, allowing dynamic control of bird behavior.
- Flock interest zones can be placed in monuments to attract bird flocks; corpses briefly draw crow flocks, and timed explosives cause flocks to flee, adding new strategic environmental interactions.
- Bird hit‑registration bounds have been increased, keeping birds within hit‑reg range and making them easier to target in combat.
